Not published.** Mike Harris · Mayor · challenger. Scored 2 Sep 2026 against **The Program — A City That Works v1.10 (31 Jul 2026)** using the 12-topic template and Decision 14. **The letter on this card is a dash.** An internal proposal sits at the bottom of the page and is Joa's to apply or reject. Evidence base is the authorized 2026 campaign site (single page; no dated posts, no costings). Challenger: no 2022–26 City term, so no Record lines and no incumbent haircut. 2023/2024 provincial runs are sourced record in the working notes, not Plan cells. ## Card

### The five doors (front of the live card) Each door is **said / record / yes / —**: a sourced sentence or a fact. Never a second grade.
Door Measure said / record / yes / — sentence or fact URL date

Downtown order M26 / M27 **said** "Make public safety and clean, accessible public spaces core priorities—combining compassion, coordination and accountability." No Public Order Team, no bylaw hours. ## The 12 topics Column key: **answer** = the mark · **quote or fact** = the verbatim sentence, then context · **URL** · **date** = lastmod, retrieved. A dash is unknown, not a fail. ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
1 M6 housing supply + composition — No published unit target, composition share, missing-middle position or tenure mix. "homes built and real affordability" sits inside the sentence already scored on row 3. One sentence, one measure. — —
2 M6b land bank + co-ops — City land, land bank and co-ops do not appear. Real-estate and construction background is not a source. — —
3 M7 permits + AI pre-screening **Close 2.0** "Set measurable permit targets, reduce avoidable delays and judge policy by homes built and real affordability." · Commits to permit-time targets and delay reduction. Comparable to M7's permit half. AI pre-screening is not named. No published day-count or category. [https://mike4victoria.ca/](https://mike4victoria.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
4 M7b pattern-book housing — Pre-approved designs do not appear. — —
5 M8/M8b 5% vacancy, DCC cuts, suite amnesty — No vacancy target, no DCC, no suite amnesty. — —
### 2 · Downtown order
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
6 M26 Public Order Team **Partial 1.0** "Make public safety and clean, accessible public spaces core priorities—combining compassion, coordination and accountability." · Commits to coordinated public safety as a core priority, with no Public Order Team, no unified command and no co-located desk. The downtown measurable-plan sentence is scored once, on row 18. Clean and accessible in this sentence are not given a second mark. [https://mike4victoria.ca/](https://mike4victoria.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
7 M26b civilian crisis response — Civilian crisis response is not named. Compassion in the row-6 sentence is not a responder model. — —
8 M27 bylaw hours 6am–10pm — No bylaw-enforcement hours position. — —
9 M28 data-targeted enforcement — No position on targeting chronic disorder drivers with data. "measurable" on the downtown plan is scored on row 18, not as an enforcement-targeting instrument. — —
10 M33 daytime sheltering bylaws — Sheltering bylaws do not appear on the 2026 site. 2024 provincial Langford text on encampments is not a Victoria 2026 measure and is not scored here. — —
11 M33b drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure) — Buffer zones and child-focused spaces do not appear on the 2026 site. 2024 provincial drug-policy sentences are not a Victoria 2026 measure and are not scored here. — —
12 M34–M37 encampments, reclaiming spaces, night lighting — Encampments, removal protocol and night lighting do not appear on the 2026 site. The 2024 Langford newsletter on encampments is provincial, not a 2026 municipal Plan cell. — —
### 3 · Household bill
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
13 M66 tax glide path (capped on the residential rate) — Respect for taxpayers raises the fiscal topic with no residential rate, cap, formula or year-path. Mention, so a dash. Review-spending is scored on row 42. The six-question cost question is used as context on row 50, not as a tax rule. — —
14 M66b/c over-collection refund + debt rule — No over-collection refund, no debt rule, no supermajority override. — —
15 M66d the Household Bill — The combined household number, water, sewer and stormwater do not appear. — —
16 M70/M70b provincial downloading ledger — No downloading ledger, no refusal threshold, no published transfer table. "Is it a municipal responsibility?" is the sixth-test cluster's first question and is used as context on row 41, not as a downloading instrument. — —
17 M70c CRD cost and the Goldstream plant — The CRD, regional water rates and the filtration plant do not appear. — —
18 M71–M73d business, downtown, one mandate not a new office **Partial 1.0** "Build a measurable plan for a downtown that is clean, safe, welcoming, accessible and alive." · Commits to a downtown plan with measurability, with no vacancy target, no Strategic Economic Plan, no flagship event, no mandate and no new office. Clean / safe / accessible in this sentence are not given a second mark. [https://mike4victoria.ca/](https://mike4victoria.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
19 M74/M75/M76 capital threshold, short-stay parking (15-min grace; first-hour gated Year 2), permit fees — No 15-minute grace, no first-hour rule, no capital-approval threshold, no permit-fee schedule. The six-question spend test is scored on row 50, not as a capital threshold. — —
### 4 · Host Nations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
20 M1–M5 Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5. — No government-to-government tables, procurement, place names, protocols or liaison. Business background is not a source. — —
### 5 · Homelessness and waitlists
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
21 M9/M9b/M64 tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated) — Demoviction, short-term rentals and indoor heat do not appear. M9c is struck. — —
22 M10 transparent algorithmic waitlists — Housing allocation and waitlists do not appear. — —
23 M11 Housing First + STEP throughput — Homelessness pathways, Housing First and STEP throughput do not appear on the 2026 site. Compassion in the row-6 sentence is not a housing-led response. 2024 provincial encampment text is not scored here. — —
### 6 · Families
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
24 M12/M13b/M13c childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is \$0 → M13d) — Childcare spaces, family-doctor recruitment and the 18–25 cohort do not appear. Husband / father / grandfather is personal background, not a source. — —
25 M13d standing School District 61 agreement — Schools and SD61 do not appear. M13 school food is \$0 and lives here, not on row 24. — —
### 7 · Streets and mobility
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
26 M14/M16/M17/M18 cleanliness and the public realm — "clean, accessible public spaces" sits inside the sentence already scored on row 6. One sentence, one measure. No graffiti, pest, sanitation-hours or public-art instrument. — —
27 M19/M22/M38/M40–M42b mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38) — No corridor, signal, intersection, school-zone or safety-audit position. M39 is struck. — —
28 M20b/M23b walking and transit the City controls — Walking, sidewalks, crossings and the City's own transit levers are not addressed. 2023 provincial highway-congestion answers are not a Victoria 2026 measure. — —
29 M24b/M25b accessibility and public washrooms — "accessible" sits inside the sentences already scored on rows 6 and 18. One sentence, one measure. No accessibility audit, no public-washroom programme. — —
30 M25 fix roads first — No maintenance backlog, pothole standard or sequencing rule. — —
### 8 · Policing and published safety
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
31 M28b business security cost-spreading — Business security costs do not appear. — —
32 M28d community paramedicine — Paramedicine and call-volume reduction do not appear. — —
33 M29/M29b VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force) — No VicPD funding, Esquimalt or regional-review position. Public safety in the row-6 sentence is not a funding formula. — —
34 M30 smart LED lights, no surveillance — Streetlighting and the surveillance limit do not appear. — —
35 M31/M31b/M31c/M32 safety dashboard, published enforcement record, crime target — No safety dashboard, no crime-reduction number. "How will we measure success?" and "Did it work?" sit inside the six-question test scored on row 50; show-value-per-tax-dollar is scored on row 42. Not a public-safety KPI set. — —
### 9 · Beauty as a public good
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
36 M43–M46b heritage and cultural venues — Heritage standards, street furniture and cultural venues do not appear. — —
37 M45b/c pedestrianisation and the signature project — Pedestrianisation and a signature-project shortlist do not appear. "Bring back the best of downtown" is scored once, on row 18, as a downtown plan, not as a pedestrianisation instrument. — —
38 M47–M49 heritage incentives, lighting, parks — Heritage incentives, ornamental lighting and parks do not appear. — —
39 M50/M50b/M51/M52 culture, sport, and the arts funding floor — Arts, sport and a funding floor do not appear. — —
### 10 · A smaller scored Hall
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
40 M15 managed competition — Competitive testing of City services does not appear. "Is there a simpler or less expensive way?" is inside the six-question test scored on row 50, not a managed-competition programme. — —
41 M65 rotating zero-based reviews **Close 2.0** "Launch an independent organizational and value-for-money review—and make the findings public." · Commits to an independent VFM review with public findings. Comparable to rotating ZBB, not the same cycle, and no savings number. Context, not scored separately: the six-question test opens with "Is it a municipal responsibility?" which is M65's jurisdiction test; the VFM sentence is the stronger instrument and takes the cell. [https://mike4victoria.ca/](https://mike4victoria.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
42 M67 quarterly performance dashboard **Partial 1.0** "Review spending, reduce duplication and require City Hall to show what residents receive for every tax dollar." · Commits to show value per tax dollar, with no quarterly dashboard, no KPI set and no publication cadence. The VFM review is scored once, on row 41. Reduce-duplication in this sentence is not given a second mark on row 43. [https://mike4victoria.ca/](https://mike4victoria.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
43 M68 overhead reduction by attrition — Headcount, attrition and administrative overhead do not appear. "reduce duplication" is inside the sentence already scored on row 42. — —
44 M69 real-estate rationalisation — City real-estate holdings do not appear. Real-estate professional background is not a source. — —
45 M53/M53b/M53c GIS, AI consultation imagery, LIDAR — GIS, consultation imagery and LIDAR do not appear. — —
46 M53d published municipal AI standard — Municipal use of AI does not appear. M7's AI pre-screening half is already noted as absent on row 3. — —
47 M54–M57 local-tech procurement, open data, Wi-Fi, EV charging — Procurement, open data, Wi-Fi and EV charging do not appear. — —
### 11 · Climate and trees as operations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date

49 M59–M63 trees, mode share, ecosystems, emergency preparedness — No published position on trees, canopy, mode share, ecosystems or emergency preparedness. — —
### 12 · Neighbourhoods and integrity
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date

Context, same block, not scored separately: "What will it really cost?" / "How will we measure success?" / "Did it work?" [https://mike4victoria.ca/](https://mike4victoria.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02

52 M79c–f lobbyist registry, FOI fee, remuneration — Lobbyist registry, FOI fees, mandate letters and council pay do not appear. The January 2026 Elections BC flyer fine is campaign-administration history, not a City FOI or integrity instrument, and is not scored here. — —
53 M80/M80b/M80c neighbourhoods, language access, Local Area Plans **Partial 1.0** "Listen directly to communities, publish what Mike hears and report back on the action taken." · Commits to a 12-neighbourhood listening programme and a public "What Victoria Told Mike" report, with no grant line, no language access and no Local Area Plan programme. Context: named neighbourhoods Burnside / Rock Bay through Victoria West. [https://mike4victoria.ca/](https://mike4victoria.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
54 M82/M82b community surveys, turnout and ballot access — The "What Victoria Told Mike" report is a campaign listening product, already scored on row 53. It is not a City annual survey, advance-vote or ballot-access instrument. Mention of listening, already used, so a dash. — —
55 M81 Saanich amalgamation (one line, not the whole topic) — Amalgamation does not appear. — —
## Working notes (internal, not for the cell) - **Sources read in full:** [mike4victoria.ca home / plan](https://mike4victoria.ca/) (retrieved 2026-09-02; single-page site, `/meet-mike` 404, no lastmod, no dated archive) · [Times Colonist Langford-Highlands questionnaire, published 30 Sep 2024](https://www.timescolonist.com/2024-bc-votes/mike-harris-conservative-party-candidate-for-langford-highlands-9594339) · [Times Colonist 2023 Langford–Juan de Fuca by-election profile](https://www.timescolonist.com/highlights/candidate-profiles-for-the-june-24-byelection-in-langford-juan-de-fuca-7153207) · [Goldstream, 9 Oct 2024, three-question riding survey](https://goldstreamgazette.com/2024/10/09/langford-highlands-candidates-address-the-issues/) · [Goldstream, 26 Sep 2024, campaign-newsletter profile](https://goldstreamgazette.com/2024/09/26/bc-conservative-candidate-concerned-with-cost-of-living-in-langford-highlands/) · [Island Social Trends, 2024 result 8,038 / 37.80%](https://islandsocialtrends.ca/runner-up-mike-harris-thanks-his-campaign-team/) · [CHEK, 28 Jan 2026, Elections BC flyer fine](https://cheknews.ca/langford-highlands-conservative-candidate-fined-for-failing-to-include-authorization-statement-1302201/) · [Elections BC enforcement notice, 27 Jan 2026](https://www.elections.bc.ca/docs/amp/Enforcement-Notice-Mike-Harris-2026.pdf) · [ACTW live profile](https://acitythatworks.ca/profiles/harris) (verified Decision 14 letter —) · [VoteMate Victoria mayor list, riding 804](https://votemate.org/bc2026/candidates?riding=804) — Harris not listed · [City of Victoria nominations page](https://www.victoria.ca/city-government/elections) — mayor nominations showing Alto and Atkinson as of retrieve; Harris not yet on the accepted list. - **Searched and not found:** any 2026 municipal questionnaire; any VoteMate 2026 Harris profile; any independent long-form interview about the Victoria mayoral programme; dated policy papers, budget, or implementation calendar on the campaign site. Absence is recorded as absence, not as a fail. Social channels were not fetched this pass (instruction: do not touch social); they are not used as Plan cells. - **One sentence, one measure — the ledger.** Seven 2026-site sentences carry the seven scored cells: (1) measurable permit targets / reduce avoidable delays → row 3. (2) public safety and clean, accessible public spaces / compassion, coordination, accountability → row 6. (3) measurable downtown plan → row 18. (4) independent organizational and value-for-money review, findings public → row 41. (5) review spending, reduce duplication, show what residents receive for every tax dollar → row 42. (6) "Have we listened to the people affected?" → row 50. (7) listen directly to communities, publish what Mike hears, report back → row 53. - **Contested allocations, recorded so they can be re-argued.** Row 3 Close 2.0 is the highest mark: permit-time targets are M7's permit half, not AI pre-screening, so not Aligned. Row 6 Partial 1.0 (not Close) because "coordination" is not a Public Order Team; face-test would not let us tell him he proposed unified command. Row 50 Partial 1.0 (not Weak, not dash): the sixth question is a named pre-spend consultation commitment, stronger than a tone-of-listening mention, weaker than a \$25M / 5-step / material-change instrument. Row 53 stays Partial, not Close: a 12-neighbourhood listening tour is not comparable to grants, language access or Local Area Plans. The six-question test as a whole could have sat on row 41 (jurisdiction + cheaper-way + measure-success) instead of the VFM review; VFM is the stronger M65 instrument and takes the cell. Q1 of the test ("Is it a municipal responsibility?") is therefore context on row 41, not a second mark. - **Provincial text is not a 2026 Plan cell.** 2023/2024 questionnaires and the Sep 2024 Langford newsletter (encampments, open drug use, building-code / permit wait times as MLA asks, carbon tax, healthcare, resources, highways) are about a provincial seat. They are not scored on any of the 55 unless the sentence is a Victoria 2026 measure. The 2026 site has its own permit-targets sentence, which is the M7 source. - **FLAG — residence.** 30 Sep 2024 Times Colonist questionnaire: "Yes, I live in the Happy Valley area with my wife for the last 4 years." The 2023 by-election profile said two years in Langford. The 2026 mayoral site does not state a current City of Victoria residence. Do not infer a move. Verify nomination papers and the City's declaration after **11 Sep 2026**. This FLAG is not a grade and is not used to mark any cell. - **FLAG — 2023/2024 provincial runs.** BC Conservative candidate, June 2023 Langford–Juan de Fuca by-election and October 2024 Langford-Highlands general election; 2024 reported final result **8,038 votes / 37.8%**, second to the NDP. Then a 2025 federal nomination bid in Cowichan–Malahat–Langford. Sourced electoral record, **not an ACTW endorsement**, and not a 2026 municipal Plan cell. The 2026 site does not foreground a party label. Never-list observed: no banned names used as a source or analogy. - **FLAG — campaign-administration, not a policy score.** Elections BC enforcement notice 27 Jan 2026 / CHEK 28 Jan 2026: \$450 fine because about 45,000 flyers from the 2024 provincial campaign lacked the required authorization statement. Findings: no deliberate attempt to circumvent, campaign cooperated, no prior fines, penalty well below the \$10,000 maximum. Recorded here, not as 📋 Record (no City office 2022–26) and not as a scored cell. - **Not a source, applied:** 30+ years in real estate, housing, construction and business; former journeyman carpenter; award-winning real-estate professional; Harris Auto Group owner listing; husband / father / grandfather. Professional background and a seat sought elsewhere are not sources. Third-party provincial-party framing is not a source. - **Actions found that contradict a 2026 sentence:** none. No City office held 2022–26, so there is no record to weigh, no 📋 line, and no incumbent cap. Challenger rule applied: 2026 plan taken at face value. - **Rows to put to the candidate before publication:** row 3 (what is the permit-time number?) · row 6 (is coordination a named team?) · row 13 (is there a residential-rate cap?) · row 41 (does the VFM review rotate, and is there a savings number?) · row 53 (does listening become a Local Area Plan or a grant line?) · **residence** (Happy Valley 2024 vs Victoria 2026 nomination papers after 11 Sep). - **Next mandatory re-check:** after nominations close **11 Sep 2026**, including residence / nomination papers, and immediately on any detailed platform release. The site carries no lastmod, so re-checks are by retrieval date only. - M83 (civic access / public correction, \$0) has no cell in this 55. Not scored. ## INTERNAL proposed letter — not the live letter **PROPOSE: C** · n = 7 · mean 1.29 Sum of scored marks: 2.0 + 1.0 + 1.0 + 2.0 + 1.0 + 1.0 + 1.0 = **9.0** across **7** scored cells. Mean **1.286**, band **C** (1.25–1.49). C is already one of the five live letters, so no mapping is needed. **This is a proposal, not the live letter.** The card above shows **—**. The live letter waits for Joa's click and compute must not overwrite it. Alignment compute APPLIED for Harris stays **—**. Live profile Decision 14 letter is **—**. **What the proposal is measuring.** Not hostility to the Program — he is not Opposed on a single cell — but distance from it. Two Closes (permit targets; independent VFM review) and five Partials (coordinated safety; downtown plan; show value per tax dollar; consult before spend; 12 neighbourhoods). Forty-eight cells are dashes because he has not spoken to them, not because he failed them. FLAGS (residence, provincial runs, flyer fine) were not used to invent a mark. **Fragility.** Drop row 50 as a Mention and n = 6, mean 1.33, still C. Drop row 6 as a Mention and n = 6, mean 1.33, still C. Drop both Closes to Partial and the mean is 1.00 (C− → **C** on the live set). Under 5 scored answers the live letter stays a dash by rule; at n = 7 the proposal is thin but over the threshold. A single costed fiscal or housing-composition paragraph is the difference between C and a higher band.
